title: Assistant Creative Designer Intern, Events & Visual Merchandising – Watches & Fine Jewelry (Stage)
note: Window display and event design for Chanel watches and fine jewelry; aimed at 4th/5th-year art, design or interior architecture students; posting is in French.

facts.summary: Six-month internship in the window and event design studio of Chanel's watches and fine jewelry art direction.
facts.duties: Help with creative concepts (mock-ups, form and material studies, mood boards, sketches), develop display decor variations with plans and 3D models, prepare installation guidelines for markets, follow suppliers and prototypes, help with installations, do competitor store visits.
facts.requirements: Art, design or interior architecture school at Bac+4/5 level; Adobe Suite, Rhino and one of V-Ray, KeyShot or Blender.
